narrative.en: Architect of Lynx at ByteDance, an open source, cross platform framework powering TikTok and CapCut. Making interfaces better for more users, more developers, and more machines, and exploring what app frameworks should look like in the age of AI.
narrative.zh: 字节跳动 Lynx 架构师。Lynx 是驱动 TikTok 与剪映的开源跨平台框架。让界面更好地服务更多用户、更多开发者、更多机器，并探索 AI 时代的应用框架应当长成什么样子。

keywords.zh: 跨平台, React, 性能优化

narrative.en: From RIT's programming languages lab to Meta's React org. Built Hermes for iOS, co-founded React Forget as tech lead of the auto-memoization compiler, and shipped to billions through React Native.
narrative.zh: 从 RIT 编程语言实验室到 Meta React 团队。将 Hermes 引入 iOS，作为 React Forget 自动记忆化编译器的联合创始工程师及技术负责人，通过 React Native 服务数十亿用户。

keywords.zh: React, 编译器, JavaScript 引擎

title.zh: Vibe³：用 Lynx 做跨平台应用 · TikTok 黑客松

description.en: A hands on workshop and hackathon at WeAreDevelopers World Congress. Vibe code once and bring the same app to web, mobile, and desktop with Lynx, plus a look at AI native app infra: AI Ergonomic, AI Efficient, and AI Expressive.
description.zh: WeAreDevelopers World Congress 上的动手工作坊与黑客松。用 Lynx 一次 vibe code，把同一套应用带到 Web、移动端和桌面；并讨论 AI 原生应用基建：对 AI 友好、对 token 经济、对意图表达。

preview.description: Hands on workshop and TikTok hackathon at WeAreDevelopers World Congress 2026 Europe. Vibe code once with Lynx for web, mobile, and desktop.

title.en: Why AI Agents Deserve a Better App Framework
title.zh: 为什么 AI Agent 配得上更好的应用框架

description.en: AI is transforming how apps are built, but not what they are built on. Without a cross platform framework, agents must generate, verify, and maintain separate code for every platform. This talk introduces Lynx and three principles for AI native app infrastructure (AI Ergonomic, AI Efficient, AI Expressive), with vue-lynx vibe coded in two weeks as the demo.
description.zh: AI 正在改变应用如何被构建，却还没改变它们构建在什么之上。没有跨平台框架，Agent 就得为每个平台分别生成、验证和维护代码。这次演讲介绍 Lynx，以及 AI 原生应用基建的三条原则：对 AI 友好、对 token 经济、对意图表达，并以两周 vibe code 出的 vue-lynx 作为演示。

preview.title: Why AI Agents Deserve a Better App Framework
preview.description: GOSIM Paris 2026. Lynx and three principles for AI native app infrastructure, with vue-lynx as the demo.

description.en: The Chinese telling of React for Two Threads. Lynx's dual threaded React, instant first frame rendering, and what changes when the UI thread is first class. With Ziqi Zhen and Haoyang Wang.
description.zh: 《React for Two Threads》的中文场。讲 Lynx 的双线程 React、瞬时首帧渲染，以及当 UI 线程成为一等公民之后会涌现什么。与甄子琦、王浩阳一起。

description.en: TikTok's production ready UI framework, Lynx, eliminates single thread bottlenecks. Write standard JavaScript and CSS to render buttery smooth, truly native mobile primitives, without the sluggishness of WebView wrappers.
description.zh: TikTok 投入生产的 UI 框架 Lynx，用来消解单线程瓶颈。用标准 JavaScript 与 CSS 渲染丝滑、真正原生的移动端原语，而不是套一层迟滞的 WebView。

preview.title: Lynx: Native for More
preview.description: WeAreDevelopers World Congress 2025. Xuan Huang on Lynx, TikTok's production ready UI framework.

title.en: Lynx: Making ByteDance Beat Across Platforms

description.en: As client products mature and fragment, cross platform has become the default choice for many developers and companies. At the same time, UI framework innovation is converging, the approaches look more and more alike, and the market is settling into a fixed shape. Against that backdrop, why did Lynx, the cross platform technology ByteDance nurtured for years, decide to go open source? This talk lifts the veil on Lynx and looks at the insights and the future of cross platform together.
description.zh: 伴随终端业务的成熟和碎片化，跨端已成为众多开发者和企业的首选。但同时，UI 框架的创新在收敛，跨端思路大同小异，市场格局趋于固化。在这个背景下，字节孕育多年的跨端技术 —— Lynx，为何决定走向开源？本演讲将揭开 Lynx 的“神秘面纱”，与你一同探寻跨端的洞见与未来。

conference.name: 第 19 届 D2 终端技术大会

description.en: Lynx, a new cross-platform stack adopted by the TikTok app that empowers teams to ship truly native UIs to mobile and web from a single codebase using their existing web skills like CSS and React, has recently been open sourced. In this talk, we'll explore what makes Lynx familiar and what sets it apart from other cross-platform technologies; we'll take a closer look at its dual-threaded design, and how that enables Lynx's instant launches and silky-smooth interactions, plus a sneak peek at what's next for Lynx.
description.zh: Lynx 是 TikTok 应用采用的全新跨平台技术栈，让团队用 CSS、React 等既有的 Web 技能，从同一套代码交付面向移动端与 Web 的真正原生 UI，并已于近期开源。本次演讲将探讨 Lynx 为何既熟悉又与众不同，深入其双线程架构，看它如何带来瞬时启动与丝滑交互，并预告 Lynx 的下一步。

description.en: For over a decade, we've lived in a universe where programming UIs with React on the client-side, from event handling to rendering, has been ruled by a single JavaScript thread. But what if React had been born differently? What if, from day one, it had been designed to fully embrace two threads? What benefits would that unlock? What challenges would we face? And what new features, abstractions, and patterns might emerge? What if this isn't just imagination... but something that exists today?
description.zh: 十多年来，我们身处这样一个宇宙：在客户端用 React 编写 UI，从事件处理到渲染，始终由单一 JavaScript 线程主宰。但如果 React 生来不同呢？如果从第一天起，它就被设计为彻底拥抱两个线程呢？这会解锁哪些收益？我们又会面临什么挑战？会涌现出哪些新特性、抽象与范式？而这一切如果不只是想象，而是今天已然存在的现实呢？

description.en: A companion interview at React Universe Conf, going behind the scenes of React for Two Threads and Lynx's dual-threaded design.
description.zh: React Universe 大会的配套访谈，聊聊《为双线程而生的 React》与 Lynx 双线程设计的台前幕后。

description.en: Ready-to-use components are vital to delivering user interfaces with velocity and scale. Introducing lynx-ui, the newest member of the Lynx family of cross-platform technologies behind TikTok. By taking advantage of Lynx's dual-threaded architecture, it offers high performance and native-graded interactivity. Join us to learn how we built it, and how it unlocks Lynx to scale across a massive range of products, even faster.
description.zh: 开箱即用的组件对于高速、规模化地交付用户界面至关重要。让我们隆重介绍 lynx-ui —— TikTok 背后 Lynx 跨平台技术家族的最新成员。借助 Lynx 的双线程架构，它带来高性能与原生级的交互体验。一起来了解我们如何构建它，以及它如何让 Lynx 更快地扩展到海量产品之中。

description.en: A panel discussion at React Advanced London on the promise and reality of cross-platform UI — writing once and rendering natively everywhere.
description.zh: React Advanced London 上的圆桌讨论，探讨跨平台 UI 的愿景与现实——一次编写，在各端原生渲染。

title.en: Frontend is Dead, Long Live Frontend

description.en: In 2023 the hottest thing about frontend was not a framework. It was the line "frontend is dead." Looking back and ahead, in this constantly shifting digital world frontend has "died" before, and it will "die" again. Every leap, from PC to Web to mobile, and now as we stand at the edge of AI and the metaverse, the form may change, but frontend as the bond between humans and machines is eternal. This talk reviews the inflection points in that evolution, and looks ahead at what comes next.
description.zh: 2023 年聊起前端，最火的并不是哪个框架，而是那句「前端已死」。放眼过去和未来，在这个不断变化的数字世界里，前端不但「死」过，而且还一定会再「死」。每一次跃迁 —— 从 PC 到 Web 到移动时代，再到现在我们正站在 AI 的风口浪尖和元宇宙的边缘 —— 或许形式会不同，但前端作为人与机器纽带的本质是永恒的。本演讲将回顾大前端技术演化中的拐点，并对下一个世代的前端趋势做一些展望和猜想。

commentary.en: Frontend as a job title may fade. Frontend as the bond between humans and machines will not.
commentary.zh: 作为岗位的前端或许会消亡，但作为人机交互纽带的前端不会。

description.en: Is frontend dead, or is it the future? And when we say frontend, what are we actually talking about? Inspired by Qi Lu's talk on large models, a look at the inflection points in frontend's evolution, and a guess at what frontend (and frontend engineers) become in the next generation: AI, AVXR, and beyond.
description.zh: 前端已死，又或是前端未来？当我们在说前端时，我们又在说什么？受陆奇博士的大模型演讲启发，不妨我们也来探讨一些大前端技术演化中的拐点，对下个世代（ AI、AVXR …）的前端（工程师）做一点猜想。

description.en: Open-source cross-platform UI framework behind TikTok, Douyin, and CapCut. Familiar React and CSS, native rendering, dual-threaded architecture — instant launch and main-thread interactivity. Open-sourced in March 2025.
description.zh: 支撑 TikTok、抖音、CapCut 的开源跨平台 UI 框架。熟悉的 React 与 CSS、原生渲染、双线程架构——瞬时启动与主线程交互。2025 年 3 月开源。

commentary.en: Not a better React Native. The bet is that web skills plus a two-thread runtime can unlock native — for more platforms, more products, more people.
commentary.zh: 不是更好的 React Native。赌注是：Web 技能加上双线程运行时，能把原生能力解锁给更多平台、更多产品、更多人。

description.en: Named one of 33 China Open Source Pioneers by SegmentFault.
description.zh: 被 SegmentFault 评选为中国开源先锋 33 人之一。

description.en: A look back and a look ahead at what has happened, and what is about to happen, across the React ecosystem. React core, web, cross platform, libraries, frameworks, docs, tools: the whole picture. Hoping it helps you see React's big picture.
description.zh: 跟大家一起回顾以及展望一下 React 整个生态这一段时期以来已经发生和将要发生的一些变化，力求涵盖 React 核心、Web、跨平台、库、框架、文档、工具等整个 React 生态的方方面面，希望能对大家理解 React 的整个 big picture 有帮助！

description.zh: 被 Gitee 评为封面人物。

description.en: The introductory talk on React Forget (now the React Compiler), an auto-memoizing compiler so you can write React without memo, useMemo, and useCallback.
description.zh: React Forget（现 React Compiler）的首次公开演讲：一个自动记忆化编译器，让你可以不用手写 memo、useMemo 和 useCallback。

description.en: JavaScript engine optimized for React Native, built by the Programming Language & Runtime (PL&R) team. Led the effort to bring Hermes to iOS.
description.zh: 由 Programming Language & Runtime（PL&R）团队打造，为 React Native 优化的 JavaScript 引擎。主导将 Hermes 引入 iOS 的工作。

description.en: Founding engineer of the React Compiler (formerly Forget), the auto-memoization compiler that reshapes React's authoring model.
description.zh: React Compiler（原名 Forget）的联合创始工程师 —— 重塑 React 编写模型的自动记忆化编译器。

commentary.en: The authoring model should stay clean. If memoization is load-bearing, a compiler should do it — so React can be fast by default. We called it Forget; it shipped as React Compiler.
commentary.zh: 编写模型就该是干净的。如果记忆化是刚需，那就该由编译器来做——让 React 默认就很快。我们当时叫它 Forget，后来以 React Compiler 落地。

title.zh: WasmCert：用 Coq 形式化 WebAssembly

description.en: Master's capstone and thesis, "A Mechanized Formalization of the WebAssembly Specification in Coq", advised by Prof. Matthew Fluet. A mechanization of the W3C WebAssembly Core Specification 1.0 in the Coq proof assistant, with a (nearly complete) machine-checked proof that the language is sound, implying both type safety and memory safety. Unlike prior work it follows the standard itself, which exposed issues in the spec and led to fixes.
description.zh: 硕士毕业设计与论文《A Mechanized Formalization of the WebAssembly Specification in Coq》，导师 Matthew Fluet 教授。在 Coq 证明助手中机械化 W3C WebAssembly Core Specification 1.0，并（基本）完成了语言可靠性（soundness）的机器验证证明，由此得出类型安全与内存安全。与先前工作不同，它紧贴标准本身，因此发现了规范中的问题并提出了修正。

preview.title: A Mechanized Formalization of the WebAssembly Specification in Coq
preview.description: RIT Computer Science · Capstone Report · 2019. A mechanization of the W3C WebAssembly Core Specification 1.0 in Coq, with a machine-checked soundness proof.

media.alt: Capstone poster, RIT Computer Science, Fall 2019.

preview.description: Xuan Huang · 2019 · on Semantic Scholar, with the papers that cite it.

commentary.en: 144 pages of W3C spec, about 5,000 lines of Coq. Applying formal verification, we show WebAssembly is safe.
commentary.zh: 144 页 W3C 规范，约 5000 行 Coq。用形式化验证，证明 WebAssembly 是安全的。
